This appeal is filed by the claimant seeking enhancement of compensation being aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 30.12.2013 passed in MVC No.279/2011 on the file of Member, MACT-II,
Bagalakote (for short, 'Tribunal').
2.

Learned counsel Sri.Prakash N. Hosamane for the appellant/claimant and learned counsel Sri.Lingaraj Maradi for the respondent/owner of the vehicle in question jointly submit that the matter is amicably settled between the parties and accordingly, they have filed a joint memo, which reads as under:
The appellant and respondent in the above appeal submit that the above matter is amicably settled between them.

1. The respondent has agreed to pay Rs.1,00,000/-
to the appellant in full and final settlement of compensation arising out of the road traffic accident in MVC No.279/2011 dated 30.12.2013 by the MACT-III, Bagalakot.
2. The respondent submitted Banker's Cheque of Rs.1,00,000/- bearing No.003089 in the name of the appellant and the appellant has received the same before this Hon'ble Court.

Therefore, the respondent will be paying the total amount of Rs.1,00,000/-
to the appellant.
Hence, this joint memo may be accepted and necessary orders may be passed in the interest of justice.
3. The joint memo is placed on record.
The appellant- Srikant Neelnaik, who is present before the Court acknowledges the receipt of the amount referred in the joint memo.
In view of the same, the appeal stands disposed off in terms of the joint memo.
The registry to draw the award accordingly.

Sd/-
JUDGE JTR Shrikant S/O. Ashok Neelnaik vs Dharmappa S/O. Kushappa Chawan on 15 April, 2024
